payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the BLEU score improvement achieved by the proposed Insertion-Deletion Transformer compared to the insertion-only model, quantifying the difference in BLEU points.

claims.text: The proposed Insertion-Deletion Transformer improves the BLEU score by around 2 points over the insertion-only model.
The Insertion-Deletion framework significantly increases the BLEU score compared to the insertion-only framework.
The Insertion-Deletion model outperforms the Insertion Transformer significantly on the task of shifting alphabetic sequences.
